attempts.transport: Native Node HTTPS IPv4 connectivity probe
PowerShell signed GET after labeled-role correction

conclusion: The earlier HTTP401/API40101 resulted from our local importer assigning the Secret to the API Key field. Correcting the explicit labels produced HTTP200/code0. This was an operator configuration error, not evidence that the user credential was invalid. Native Node connectivity was a separate local transport problem; the production Windows bridge subsequently returned four successful read-only endpoints.
reproduction: Use explicit OC_API_KEY / OC_SECRET_KEY roles in an ignored local .env. Windows PowerShell 7.5+ JSON parsing must preserve the ISO timestamp as a string. See authenticated-rwa.json and windows-transport.md. No credentials or signatures are published.
